Welcome to My Anime Life! A Japanese inspired life roleplay game where you can:

🔨 Customise various dorms with hundreds of furniture.
💼 Earn money through different jobs and increase your XP to earn even more.
🚗 Buy vehicles which can be colored.
🍔 Eat and drink all kinds of food to make your mood better.
🗺️ Explore many different locations that serve different purposes.

Be sure to show your support by liking 👍 and favoriting ⭐ the game.

🏆Premium players get 25% extra for daily rewards.🏆
🏆Group members get x2 passive gold.🏆

Tags: Roleplay, RP, Life Roleplay, Town & City, Create, Building, Hangout
